content: Man is the only creature who refuses to be what he is.
author: Albert Camus
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Water is the softest thing on earth, yet it carves through solid granite. It doesn't fight obstacles; it yields, flows around them, and quietly finds its way to its natural level.

Albert Camus understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When we force outcomes with brute willpower and anxiety, we exhaust ourselves and create unnecessary resistance. Aligning with nature means trusting the timing of things and moving with steady, patient persistence.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
